en: Dependent on a wholesome state originated by consciousness, there arises a state not originated by that same consciousness and not wholesome, by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*)... Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on an unwholesome state originated by consciousness, there arises a state not originated by that same consciousness and not unwholesome, by way of root condition... Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance. (For the indeterminate root, there are exactly three conditions.)
